text: Three factory edges from #416 and #417 (#422). A revise after choices for only some forks drafts again with those choices and the writer's comments, without waiting for the rest; short of a revise, the factory names the forks still open, once for each new set of choices. Ratification reuses an earlier branch only when its proposal hash and any directory the saved proposal names both match, so a project whose destination changed builds in the new directory on a fresh branch. And SIGTERM, which launchd sends on a restart, now stops a watcher's steps as SIGINT does: it ends each agent run's whole process group, descendants holding its output pipes included, waits for every step to stop, and gives up its lease, so a successor takes over at once instead of after about five minutes, and no orphaned run goes on spending the account. The first two builds failed on the plan's own gap, a Codex cancellation fix the plan's files didn't reach; the revised plan added internal/synth/codex.go.
